svg.title: MuP Adam scaling multipliers across hidden widths
svg.desc: As a hidden layer fan-in grows from 128 to 1024, the normalized hidden Adam learning-rate multiplier and output multiplier fall from 1 to one eighth. Input and output Adam learning-rate multipliers remain at one. Cursor, decaying curve and three bars change together, using schematic multiplier-form equations, not measured training losses.
svg.text: Adam multiplier form · normalized at fan-in = 128
